newsitem.title: USA: Sun Capital to put over $8.5 mln in He-Ro.
newsitem.headline: Sun Capital to put over $8.5 mln in He-Ro.

text.p: He-Ro Group Ltd said Sun Capital Partners had agreed to buy $2.5 million of the company's stock, $6 million of its subordinated debt and He-Ro stock options.
The women's evening wear manufacturer said in a statement Sun's total investment in He-Ro would equal 49.9 percent if the options and a portion of the debt was converted.
Sun would buy debt owned by He-Ro's main stockholder, Della Rounick, the company said. About $500,000 of the debt would be convertible into common stock, it said.
Rounick was the executrix of Herbert Rounick's estate.
Sun would have options to purchase He-Ro common stock at declining exercise prices, based on a formula linked to the company's performance, He-Ro said.

"The attempt to bring together this alliance is consistent with our continuing efforts to bring the company back to profitability, and further demonstrates the company's commitment to all of its retail customers, employees, vendors and stockholders," William Carone, co-chairman on the board, said in a statement.
The transaction was subject to due diligence, obtaining financing, certain third party approvals and other conditions.
